sources.title: Seedance API — Seedance 2.5 & Seedance 2.0 | Seedance 2 - seevio.ai
sources.snippet: The API lets you submit Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0 video generation tasks programmatically. Seedance 2.5 is the recommended model and supports text-to-video, first-frame or first-and-last-frame image-to-video, and multimodal reference-to-video.
